commons.title: Howard Pyle - The Burning of Jamestown.jpg
commons.description: The Burning of Jamestown by Howard Pyle (signature lower right corner). It depicts the burning of Jamestown, Virginia during Bacon's Rebellion (A.D. 1676-77); used to illustrate the article "Jamestown" in Harper's Encyclopaedia of United States History: from 458 A.D. to 1905 (1905).
commons.editorial_reason: The illustration depicts the burning of Jamestown during Bacon's Rebellion, not Pamunkey people or identifiable Pamunkey cultural practices; the source category alone is insufficient.
